description: US House stock-trade disclosures (STOCK Act) by ticker or by member, dated by transaction. Use when the user asks: which members of Congress traded X; what did a named member buy; is Congress selling X. Not for: company insiders → get_insider_trades. Args: ticker or member; limit.

chamber.description: "house" (default): US House disclosures by ticker or member.
chamber.title: Chamber

entity.description: A company name, instead of a ticker.
entity.title: Entity

limit.description: Most trades, newest first to return.
limit.title: Limit

member.description: A House member's name: what that member traded (House only).
member.title: Member

ticker.description: A stock ticker: which members traded it.
ticker.title: Ticker

name: get_congress_trades
title: Congressional trades
